title: Experience quality baseline
description: Mandatory interaction, accessibility, responsive, and visual rules for user-interface delivery.

rules.statement: Use #0B5FFF as the primary action color, #E8F1FF as the light surface, #073B9A as the dark interaction state, and neutral backgrounds; expose them as reusable design tokens.
requiredEvidence: Token definition and rendered UI evidence

rules.statement: Pair color with text, iconography, shape, or another visible cue for status, validation, selection, and destructive actions.
Use semantic controls, visible keyboard focus, programmatic labels, sufficient color contrast, and reduced-motion support where motion is present.
Define behavior for at least one mobile width and one desktop width, prevent horizontal overflow, and keep primary actions usable without hover.
Specify and implement relevant empty, loading, success, error, disabled, focus, and destructive-action states for the approved scope.
